nparcalc

Source: R/nparcalc.R
nparcalc.Rd

Device- and moving-window-aware entry point for circadian rhythm and early-warning-signal analysis. Handles column normalization and windowing (which portion of the recording to analyze, depending on device and whether a moving window is in use), then delegates the actual statistics to circadian_metrics (IS, IV, RA, L5, M10) and ews_metrics (Mean, Variance, SD, CoV, Skewness, Kurtosis, autocorrelation, time to recovery). Kept as a single entry point for backward compatibility with existing callers/scripts.

Usage

nparcalc(myACTdevice, movingwindow, CRV.data, ACTdata.1.sub, out = NULL)

Arguments

myACTdevice

Name of the input device used. Should be either Actiwatch2 or MW8.

movingwindow

A boolean indicating whether moving window is used.

CRV.data

CRV data

ACTdata.1.sub

Managed data set

out

Optional. When movingwindow is TRUE, this is the current window of data.

Value

A named list combining the outputs of circadian_metrics and ews_metrics, plus CRV_data (the windowed data actually used for the calculations).

See also

circadian_metrics, ews_metrics
